scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: No claim for prime-factor multiplicity >=9; older/unindexed equivalent treatments cannot be ruled out categorically.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.originality_boundary: The quadriperfect equation sigma(n)=4n is narrower than four-abundancy sigma(n)>=4n and does not imply four additional strict-inequality cases.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_character: Global theorem from exact-rational branch-bound exhaustion and explicit divisor-set partition certificates, not inference from bounded numerical scan.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.theorem_domain: Positive integers n>=2, total prime-factor multiplicity at most eight; four-layered divisor partitions and ordinary divisor sum.

title: The complete first multiplicity layer of four-layered numbers
